script_text:
The stars are warning you now: Jupiter, your ruling Water planet, squares your tenth house this week, and career power is about to test your compassion.

Monday through Wednesday, that square tightens, making old confidence crack. Tuesday, Mercury opposes your seventh house, so relationship truths surface fast. Wednesday is emotionally intense because Venus enters your fifth house and scatters romantic energy.

By Thursday, Jupiter trines your second house, bringing money healing and sudden financial relief.

Friday through Sunday, that trine expands into your ninth house, so travel or spiritual belief shifts. The weekend asks for gentle faith now.

Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth house, but Monday is your worst day because Mercury opposes your seventh house.

Take one small creative risk before the trine peaks and always truly trust your healing.

Follow for your daily cosmic updates tonight, dear friend.
